# Skill: Tool Quality Gate — Codepackr Law

## Must Pass Before Done

### Privacy
- [ ] No network requests with practice data
- [ ] No analytics containing answers/scores
- [ ] localStorage is opt-in only

### UX
- [ ] Sample/Demo (where applicable)
- [ ] Reset / Clear
- [ ] Clear feedback on actions
- [ ] Empty & error states are helpful
- [ ] Keyboard accessible

### Visual & Brand
- [ ] Blue accent `#2563eb`
- [ ] `rounded-2xl` cards, `rounded-xl` controls
- [ ] Light + Dark correct
- [ ] Mobile usable

### Technical
- [ ] TypeScript clean
- [ ] Registered in tools data
- [ ] Slug / routing works
- [ ] README updated
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run build` pass

If any item is unchecked, the tool is not ready.
